connector.name: Sunaiva Gate - Agent Rule Enforcement
connector.registryDescription: MCP enforcement layer that intercepts AI agent actions and blocks rule violations before execution.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.sunaivacore.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package gate. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.sunaivacore, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SUNAIVA_GATE_API_KEY
env.description: Pro-tier API key for premium rules. Free tier (35 local rules: 27 constitutional + 8 recommended-default) needs no key.

env.name: SUNAIVA_GATE_DRY_RUN
env.description: Set to '1' to evaluate without blocking — writes 'would_have_blocked' to audit log.

env.name: DISABLE_SUNAIVA_GATE
env.description: Emergency kill-switch: set to '1' to allow all actions unconditionally.
